title: Reseller-Billed Invoices: Disputes and Credits
author: Rachel Kim
body:
## Scope
Customers who buy Redwood through a reseller receive the reseller's invoice, not Redwood's. This page covers disputes and credits on those invoices only. It is not the procedure for duplicate charges on a direct Redwood invoice; for those, use the support console credits and disputes page.

## What Support does
- Confirm in the console that the account is reseller-billed. A direct Redwood invoice in the console means this page does not apply.
- Point the customer to their reseller, who raises the dispute with Partnerships.
- Support issues no credit note and opens no dispute for a reseller-billed account: the reseller's invoice isn't in the console.

## Partnerships limits
Partnerships may credit a reseller up to $2,500 per invoice under the partner agreement. That limit has nothing to do with Support's own limits.

_Last reviewed 2026-04-02._
